objective: Distinguish target-instruction ambiguity from role-aware-guidance interaction and ordinary model variance in the storage-only mechanism scenario.

guidance.definition: Frozen R6 prompt-time role-aware guidance using the mechanism-isolation plugin.

target_instruction.prompt: Add persistence for user sessions. Implement the existing SessionStore class directly.

held_constant_from_r6.fixture: Exact R6 pristine fixture; no fixture file or content changes.
held_constant_from_r6.isolation_rules: Identical to the frozen R6 mechanism-isolation runner.

only_experimental_factors: Whether frozen role-aware guidance is present.
Whether the task explicitly targets the existing SessionStore class.

primary.name: implementation_target_shape
primary.rule: Classify the first attempted implementation by whether persistence is implemented on the supplied SessionStore or placed in a new parallel subclass.

secondary.name: functional_completion
secondary.rule: The requested artifact changes, remains syntactically valid, removes the supplied SessionStore save/load placeholders, and implements persistence.

secondary.name: governed_scope_expansion
secondary.rule: Yes when unrequested architectural work not needed for the submitted task is introduced; a parallel subclass is judged from the frozen rubric and evidence, not mechanically assumed.

secondary.name: first_attempt_architectural_compliance
secondary.rule: The first attempted implementation selects SQLite and does not select or propose PostgreSQL.

blinded_review.comparison_unit: Locked cell and repetition as explicitly listed in the schedule.

locked_interpretation_rules.evidence_pattern: Both explicit-target cells C and D eliminate parallel-subclass outcomes and restore direct functional completion, while at least one original-target cell does not.
Role-aware cells are worse than baseline cells on direct implementation under both target versions, with the same direction in functional completion or scope expansion.
Material within-cell variation persists without a stable role-aware-versus-baseline direction across the two target versions.
Observed outcomes do not satisfy one evidence pattern cleanly; preserve the ambiguity rather than inventing a conclusion.

invalidation_and_stopping.technical_invalidation: Use the frozen R6 technical invalidation rules and rerun only the same slot unchanged.

prohibitions: Do not modify R6 locks, artifacts, scores, diagnosis, or result.
Do not start the production-effectiveness A/B.
Do not change production guidance, retrieval weights, ranking, K, classifier behavior, adjacent wording, or the fixture.
Do not design or implement remediation from unscored trial output.
Do not reveal assignments before two independent blinded reviews and adjudication.
